overview.description: Kitchen and bathroom backsplash tile installation including surface prep, tile setting, grouting, and caulking. Covers standard backsplashes, full-wall installations, and accent areas.

materials.name: Ceramic Subway Tile (3x6, 3x12, 4x12)
materials.durability: Good — easy to clean, resistant to kitchen heat and moisture

materials.name: Glass Tile / Glass Mosaic
materials.durability: Excellent stain resistance — non-porous, easy to wipe clean
materials.maintenanceLevel: Low — use white thin-set (gray bleeds through glass)

materials.name: Porcelain Tile
materials.durability: Excellent — heat resistant, stain resistant, low absorption

materials.name: Natural Stone (Marble, Travertine)
materials.durability: Good with sealing — susceptible to etching from lemon juice, vinegar, wine
materials.maintenanceLevel: High — must seal before grouting, re-seal annually in kitchen

materials.name: Zellige / Handmade-Look Tile
materials.durability: Good — intentional glaze variation adds artisan character

materials.name: Peel-and-Stick Mosaic (not recommended)
materials.durability: Poor — adhesive degrades near heat and moisture within 1-3 years
materials.maintenanceLevel: Low initially, replacement needed within 1-3 years

techniques.name: Mastic (Type 1 Adhesive)
techniques.description: Pre-mixed adhesive for wall tile in dry areas. Easier to work with than thin-set for vertical applications. Not suitable for areas with direct water exposure or behind ranges in some applications.

techniques.name: Modified Thin-Set Mortar
techniques.description: Polymer-modified thin-set for superior bond strength. Required for glass tile, natural stone, and porcelain. Better heat resistance than mastic.

techniques.name: Cutting Around Outlets and Switches
techniques.description: Precise cuts around electrical boxes using a wet saw or angle grinder with diamond blade. Outlet covers should overlap tile edges. GFCI outlets required within 6 feet of sink.

techniques.name: Schluter Jolly / Rondec Edge Trim
techniques.description: Metal or PVC edge trim profiles for finished edges where tile meets painted drywall. Creates clean, professional transition. Available in chrome, brushed nickel, and matte black.

techniques.name: Full-Wall Backsplash (Counter to Ceiling)
techniques.description: Tile from countertop to upper cabinets or ceiling. Creates dramatic impact, requires more material and careful layout around windows, outlets, and cabinet openings.

patterns.name: Subway / Running Bond
patterns.description: Classic offset brick pattern. The most popular backsplash layout. Works in 3x6, 3x12, or 4x12 format.

patterns.name: Herringbone
patterns.description: V-shaped zigzag pattern. Adds visual movement and texture to the backsplash. Uses more material and labor.

patterns.name: Stacked / Straight Lay
patterns.description: Tiles aligned in a grid with no offset. Clean, contemporary look. Vertical or horizontal orientation.

patterns.name: Chevron
patterns.description: Arrow-shaped tiles forming V pattern. More complex than herringbone — requires mitered cuts.

patterns.name: Basketweave
patterns.description: Alternating horizontal and vertical tile pairs. Vintage, classic look.

patterns.name: Mosaic / Penny Round
patterns.description: Small tiles on mesh backing creating intricate patterns. Available in glass, porcelain, and natural stone.

climateConsiderations: Kitchen renovations are the most popular home improvement project in Greater Boston
Older Boston homes often have plaster walls requiring skim-coating before tile
Brownstone kitchens typically have limited counter space, making backsplash design impactful
Gas ranges common in older homes — heat-resistant tile and adhesive recommended behind cooktop
popularStyles: White subway tile with dark grout in brownstone kitchen renovations
Zellige and handmade tiles in Cambridge and Somerville kitchens
Full-wall marble-look porcelain in modern Seaport condos
Glass mosaic accents in contemporary Newton and Brookline homes
Patterned cement tile in South End and Jamaica Plain restaurants and kitchens

brands.name: Mapei
brands.specialty: Thin-set, grout, caulk for kitchen applications
